evals.prompt: Refresh README.md after adding a loadout YAML. Use the generating-readme skill. Repo has loadouts/*.yaml and docs/assets/loadout-banner.jpg.
evals.expected_output: Ran audit_loadouts.py against the template. Available loadouts table lists every loadout YAML name, Extends matches YAML, What you get names an own artifact. Banner path docs/assets/loadout-banner.jpg is unchanged. Skill was not added to any loadout YAML.
expectations: Runs scripts/audit_loadouts.py rather than hand-writing the catalog
Does not add generating-readme to loadouts/*.yaml

evals.prompt: Generate README.md for a cloned public repo that has no loadouts/ directory.
evals.expected_output: Script strips the optional loadouts section. Prose follows readme-best-practices.md. Does not copy docs/assets/loadout-banner.jpg into the foreign README.
expectations: Omits Available loadouts when loadouts/*.yaml is absent
Does not use docs/assets/loadout-banner.jpg on a foreign repo
Does not invent features the target repo does not have
